title: Decision tree computes a target
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $T$ be a decision tree on all $n$ coordinates with sign-valued output, and let $f$ be a sign-valued function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube. Then for every input $x$ in the $_2$ cube, $T(x)=f(s(x))$, where $s(x)$ is the corresponding sign vector.
hypotheses_covered: $T$ is a decision tree with all $n$ coordinates available and sign-valued output
$f$ is a sign-valued function on sign vectors of length $n
the equality holds for every input in the $_2$ cube
